title: Check the actual address
summary: A link label can differ from its destination. Read the real host name carefully before entering private information.
introduction: A link label can differ from its destination. Read the real host name carefully before entering private information. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A link label can differ from its destination. Read the real host name carefully before entering private information.

blocks.code:
Label shown: School portal
Actual host: school.example.attacker.test
Domain controlled here: attacker.test
blocks.title: Check the actual address

blocks.text: The word school appears in a subdomain; it does not make the destination the school's site. This is a fictional address.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A padlock means an encrypted connection, not that the website is honest.
For more detail later, use this [Cybersecurity Fundamentals further reading](https://www.cisa.gov/secure-our-world).
